text: AI is changing the way we think about creativity. Today, artificial intelligence can create art, compose music, and even write stories or articles. These tools are powerful because they can produce new ideas quickly and in many different styles. However, human creativity is still special. People use emotions, personal experiences, and imagination to create meaning. Machines can copy styles and produce surprising results, but they do not truly understand what they make. Many artists now use AI as a helpful partner, not a replacement. In the end, the best results often come when human creativity and machine intelligence work together.
